description: This file defines the Chart class used to parse and interpret chart-related XML data within an XLSX spreadsheet, including extracting chart titles, axes, data series, colors, layout details, and other chart properties.

classes.name: Chart
classes.description: Represents an individual chart within an XLSX file, providing methods to parse chart XML elements, extract properties, and construct Chart objects for spreadsheet reports.

methods.name: getAttribute
methods.description: Utility method to retrieve and format an XML attribute from a SimpleXMLElement based on specified data type.

methods.name: readChart
methods.description: Main method to parse a SimpleXMLElement representing a chart and construct a corresponding Chart object with all its properties.

methods.name: chartTitle
methods.description: Extracts the chart title from XML details and creates a Title object.

methods.name: chartLayoutDetails
methods.description: Parses layout details for chart elements from XML to create a Layout object.

methods.name: chartDataSeries
methods.description: Constructs a DataSeries object based on chart series XML, including series labels, categories, and values.

methods.name: chartDataSeriesValueSet
methods.description: Creates a DataSeriesValues object from XML, representing a set of data points of a specific type (number or string).

methods.name: chartDataSeriesValues
methods.description: Generates an array of DataSeriesValues from a series of XML data points, including format code and data values.

methods.name: chartDataSeriesValuesMultiLevel
methods.description: Handles multi-level data series points, supporting nested series data from XML.

methods.name: parseRichText
methods.description: Parses rich text XML into a RichText object, applying font style attributes from XML to text runs.

methods.name: parseFont
methods.description: Creates a Font object with style attributes derived from XML, used in rich text parsing.

methods.name: readChartAttributes
methods.description: Extracts attributes related to data labels and formatting from chart XML elements into an associative array.

methods.name: setChartAttributes
methods.description: Applies parsed chart attributes to a Layout object representing the plot area or other chart components.

methods.name: readEffects
methods.description: Reads and sets visual effects like glow, soft edges, and shadows on chart elements, based on XML data.

methods.name: readColor
methods.description: Parses color information from XML and returns an array with color type, value, alpha, and brightness.

methods.name: readLineStyle
methods.description: Extracts line style properties, including width, dash type, arrow styles, and color from chart XML.

methods.name: setAxisProperties
methods.description: Configures axis properties such as scaling, tick marks, labels, and text rotation based on XML data.
